intended_use: Mechanism pilot only. This same-L3 library contains source-L3-specific timing, target ranges, and parameters. Do not use it as a fair cross-L3 evaluation library without sanitizing those fields.

coverage: field preparation, base fertilizer, ridge formation, and early-zone planting
mid-zone planting-window wait, recheck, and planting
late-zone planting-window wait, seedbed irrigation, infiltration wait, and planting
post-planting emergence and stage-split scouting across staggered zones
R8 harvest-window decision, staggered harvest, unloading, drying, and storage
known_gaps: daily wait events are compressed into skill patterns rather than separate skills
observation-only management is represented as a scouting skill because the source L3 has no treatment action in the management window
same-L3 exact target ridges and parameters are useful for mechanism testing but would be leakage in cross-L3 evaluation

skill_schema.farming_group: One of establishment, management, harvest. Used by grouped retrieval; do not infer this from skill_id or task_type at runtime.
skill_schema.belief: Short state/action belief distilled from the L2: when to suspect this task, what evidence to collect, and what decision it supports.
skill_schema.oracle_events: A compact oracle-event template. For same-L3 pilot it can include exact parameters; for cross-L3 it should be generalized to parameter ranges and trigger conditions.
skill_schema.constraints: Hard agronomic/tool constraints the agent should obey.

skills.belief: If the field is unprepared and unplanted, confirm weather, forecast, seedbed soil, inventory, and tractor status. Complete field prep before planting. In this staggered L3, only early ridges 0-20 are planted in the first window.
constraints: Do not plant before field prep, base fertilizer, and ridge formation.
Do not plant mid or late zones in the early window.
Use HEINONG84, depth_cm=4.0, seed_spacing_cm=7.9 for this same-L3 pilot.
success_checks: mid and late zones remain unplanted

skills.belief: After early-zone planting, wait for the configured mid-zone planting window rather than immediately planting all remaining ridges. Recheck weather, forecast, soil, seed inventory, and planter status before planting ridges 21-42.
evidence_chain: SystemApp.advance_time(days=1) repeated for the mid window
constraints: Do not plant ridges 21-42 before the mid-zone window.
Do not modify already planted early ridges.
success_checks: ridges 43-63 remain unplanted until the late window

skills.belief: Late-zone planting requires a later window and seedbed evidence. If the late seedbed needs moisture support, irrigate ridges 43-63, wait for infiltration, then recheck before planting.
evidence_chain: SystemApp.advance_time(days=1) repeated for the late window
constraints: Do not plant ridges 43-63 before the late-zone window.
Do not irrigate the whole field when only the late seedbed needs support.
Recheck soil after infiltration before planting.
success_checks: all 64 ridges are planted after the late action
water and seed use are consistent with targeted action

skills.belief: After all zones are planted, manage the crop by scouting emergence and later stage split separately by zone. Do not treat the field unless evidence supports a real stressor.
constraints: Do not collapse the three staggered zones into one uniform stage assumption.
Do not apply fertilizer, pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, or irrigation without direct evidence.
Use ground checks to confirm what drone/canopy signals mean.
success_checks: emergence status is checked by zone
stage split across zones is visible in range-state checks
no unsupported treatment action is taken

skills.belief: At R8/harvest-window beginning, harvest timing is still a decision. Check each zone for maturity, harvest_allowed, weather, soil trafficability, grain moisture, and capacity. Harvest batches in early/mid/late order only when current evidence supports it.
constraints: Harvest requires R8 or harvest_allowed, suitable weather, trafficable soil, known grain moisture, and storage/dryer capacity.
Preserve harvest -> unload -> dry_grain -> store_grain when drying is needed.
Do not store wet grain directly.
Do not wait for unnecessary 8%-10% grain moisture.
success_checks: 64 ridges harvested by the end of the sequence
each batch has non-empty recovered grain
final recovered_yield_kg_total matches the source L3 scale
